Construction: plastic enclosure; plastic/stainless steel load receptor; dual, integral or pole-mounted LCD/LED display; operator keypad; integral printer (optional); level indicator. Devices: initial zero setting, semi-automatic zero setting, zero tracking (optional), zero indicator, stable weight indicator, semi-automatic additive or subtractive tare weighing, tare indicating, preset tare, gravity compensation, printing (optional), price-computing, PLU, price-labelling configuration (printing below Min not allowed), memory storage of transactions. Interfaces: USB, Ethernet, RS232; connection to EPOS, ECR or EFT/ECU possible. Sealing: tamper-evident wire and seal.
